name: Pumpkin & Ricotta Pasta Bake with Parmesan & Chives

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (6 ¾ cups) rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice the onions.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-low heat.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add garlic, onion, sage, and thyme. Cook until soft, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp sage
1 ½ tsp thyme

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash kale leaves, then fold in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the pan with the onions; cook, stirring often, until kale begins to wilt, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, pumpkin, ricotta, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Simmer, stirring occasionally, while pasta is cooking.
instructions.secondary_message:
531 ml (2 ¼ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) can pure pumpkin purée
1 ½ (425 g) pkg ricotta cheese
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack 10 cm under the broiler.
Wash and chop chives into small pieces.
Add ½ of the chives and Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing) to pan and stir to combine.
Drain pasta, add to pan with sauce, and stir to combine.
Place pan in the oven and broil until slightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place pasta on a plate and garnish with remaining chives and Parmesan. Enjoy!
